title: Stale quote with a large edge is hidden as a sanity anomaly instead of shown as STALE
steps: Run evidence/PSOC-script.ts (npx tsx from sigmaline): 'Fake Stale' goalscorer, best book b4 at +500, last_update 120 min old, others fresh at about +300
expected: A row whose best price is older than the stale threshold is dimmed, tagged STALE and ungraded on the price board (README rule), whatever its edge.
actual: Edge was 30.6% so filterFeed hit the sanity cap first (counts.sanity++) and the row went to anomalies: it is not on the board and is written to data_anomalies as bad data, never STALE. With the same stale quote at a 5% edge (evidence/PSOC-script2.ts) it correctly lands in `stale`. Stale quotes are exactly the ones that show big edges, so they are mis-bucketed.
evidence: evidence/PSOC-script.ts output: 'Fake Stale Goals 1+: Yes ... ev=30.59% bestTs=120m' listed under ANOM, STALE list empty
suspected_area: packages/core/src/feed.ts filterFeed: sanity check runs before the stale check (guess: swap the order)
